verdicts.evidence: Track 1 §2: contract receival, drying, bagging 'Not registered' but 'integrated with the export operation and use shared receival infrastructure'
verdicts.reason: Unregistered contract activities are integrated with the export operation on shared receival infrastructure, so the establishment is operating beyond its registered operations.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 §3: 'There are no conditions, suspensions or reviews attached to this registration'
verdicts.reason: No suspension is recorded against the registration or its operations.

verdicts.evidence: Track 5 §1 registered export area (Lot 4 FP 12247) and Track 1 §5 area description with site plan
verdicts.reason: The registered export area of the premises is documented in the site plan.

verdicts.evidence: Track 5 §2-4 adjoining sites, buildings/structures and services
verdicts.reason: Important features of the registered area, adjoining sites, buildings, facilities and services are documented.

verdicts.evidence: Track 5 §5-6 export operations layout, permanent fixtures and equipment; schematic plan
verdicts.reason: Layout of areas where export operations occur, including fixtures and equipment, is documented.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 §9: 'No changes to the registered establishment name, address, ownership, management or trading name have occurred'
verdicts.reason: No notifiable changes to registration details occurred, with an undertaking to notify DAFF if any arise.

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 §10: 'No structural alterations or additions to the registered premises have been carried out'
verdicts.reason: No physical alterations/extensions requiring approval are recorded (though operational scope expansion is captured under CP1).

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §2-4 buildings, equipment, facilities and services listed
verdicts.reason: The establishment has the buildings, equipment, facilities and services required for its export operations.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §4.2: LED lighting 550/440/418 lux, annual lux verification
verdicts.reason: Adequate lighting is provided and verified.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §4.3: amenities block with 2 toilets, 2 hand basins hot/cold, soap, paper towels
verdicts.reason: Hand washing and toilet facilities are provided.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §5.1: epoxy floors, FRP linings, stainless internals, hinged access panels
verdicts.reason: Design and construction allow effective cleaning of buildings, equipment and facilities.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §5.2: roller door seals worn with 8-22 mm gaps, cold store gasket 12 mm gap, ventilation mesh 80x40 mm hole
verdicts.reason: Worn door seals and a mesh hole compromise pest exclusion, failing the minimisation of contamination, infestation and pest harbourage.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §5.3: bunded sump, sealed lidded bins, roofed/bunded waste bay, no open waste storage
verdicts.reason: Design provides efficient and hygienic disposal of solid and liquid waste.

verdicts.evidence: Track 5 §7: DAFF Inspection Bay with stainless bench 2.1x0.8 m, 550 lux, handwash, probe set, sample fridge
verdicts.reason: Inspection area and equipment are designed for AO sample collection and inspection, including an inspection bench.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §3: cleaning and separation unit (pre-storage cleaning); Track 5 grading/optical sorter with rejects to waste
verdicts.reason: Cleaning/separation and grading equipment manage the risk of large contaminants.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §3 cleaning/separation unit; Track 5 §5 grading/sorting rejects to waste bin
verdicts.reason: Screening equipment removes large contaminants from the product.

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 Hygiene & Sanitation Plan with master cleaning schedule and SOPs
verdicts.reason: A documented system of controls to manage hygiene exists.

verdicts.evidence: Track 2 §6: '[DEFICIENCY — NOT DOCUMENTED] Waste management procedures ... are NOT included ... No written procedure or records are maintained'
verdicts.reason: The HACCP plan explicitly documents that waste procedures and records are not maintained, revealing a gap in the waste-control system (conflicts with Track 4 EWMP).

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 hygiene controls and Track 4 §6 EWMP appropriate for grain operations
verdicts.reason: The hygiene/waste controls that are documented are broadly effective for the type of operations.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3 bait station register, Track 7 21-station map, Track 2 §7 pest program
verdicts.reason: A system of controls to manage pests including rodent bait stations is in place.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 §1: 'Trend review shows low activity with completed escalation actions and closure evidence'
verdicts.reason: The pest control system is effective for the operations, with monitoring and closure evidence.

verdicts.evidence: Track 3: 'Records retained from 2025 (< 2 years — NON-COMPLIANT (C3))'; new establishment registered Oct 2024
verdicts.reason: Less than 2 years of hygiene/waste/pest records are retained.

verdicts.evidence: Track 6 §8.1: 'Records are maintained in Mandarin'
verdicts.reason: Hygiene records are kept in Mandarin, failing the requirement that records be in English.

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §7.1 'No hygiene deficiencies at most recent inspection'; Track 6 §11 all areas compliant
verdicts.reason: Areas are maintained in a clean and hygienic condition (minor debris in non-operational corners noted in Track 7).

verdicts.evidence: Track 4 §7.2 nil rodent evidence, negative insect probes; Track 3 no infestation detected
verdicts.reason: Areas are maintained so prescribed goods are not likely to be infested or contaminated.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 §2: BS-05 and BS-10 'Loose anchor'; BS-15 and BS-20 'Water ingress'
verdicts.reason: Several bait stations are not in good working order, failing the fit-for-purpose requirement.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 §4: 'Temporary overflow pesticide cartons held in open shelf area during stocktake'
verdicts.reason: Pesticide stored on open shelving creates a contamination risk to prescribed products.

verdicts.evidence: Track 7 §4: 'Chemical storage physically separated from export product handling and preparation areas'; Track 3 chemicals in separate shed 20 m from pit
verdicts.reason: Chemical storage is stated to be physically separated from product preparation areas.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 1 Receival Register with property/paddock ID, variety, grade, received by
verdicts.reason: Traceability from the source property to receival is documented.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 2 Product Movement Log with source/destination silos and ledger cross-checks
verdicts.reason: Traceability while goods are at the establishment is maintained.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 4 Dispatch/Transfer Dockets with destination premises and Dest RE No.
verdicts.reason: Traceability to the next premises is documented.

verdicts.evidence: Track 2 §8 traceability system (grower-lot-bin, lot codes) and Track 9 registers
verdicts.reason: Systems of controls (labelling, record keeping) maintain traceability and integrity.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 §2: 'Flow chart omits one alternate transfer path used during peak receival periods'
verdicts.reason: The product flow chart omits a transfer path, so it does not fully demonstrate product movement/integrity.

verdicts.evidence: Track 2 §9 Failed Goods Procedure; Track 9 Sheet 6 Rejected Goods Log
verdicts.reason: A system of controls to manage failed/rejected goods including treatment and re-presentation exists.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 §1 'temporary mesh segregation pending permanent barrier'; Track 2 §10 '[DEFICIENCY] No controls to prevent re-contamination or re-infestation between inspection and dispatch'
verdicts.reason: Contamination/infestation controls are incomplete (interim mesh barrier; no documented re-contamination controls).

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 §3: 'Substitution controls rely on single-operator checks for selected late-shift dispatches'
verdicts.reason: Single-operator dispatch checks create a substitution risk, failing the minimisation of substitution.

verdicts.evidence: Track 8 §4: 'Occasional packaging QC records attached to shift summary instead of individual lot files'
verdicts.reason: Packaging QC is performed and met; the noted issue is record filing rather than a packaging-requirement failure.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 7: 'Jan 2025 - current', 'Legacy index migration in progress'
verdicts.reason: Traceability records span under 2 years and migration is incomplete, failing the 2-year retention requirement.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 Sheet 6 'blending rationale logged in shift note only'; Sheet 7 'Rejected-goods attachments partly offsite', from 2025
verdicts.reason: Rejected/failed-goods records are under 2 years and blending rationale is not properly retained.

verdicts.evidence: Track 9 registers are in English with dates for each action
verdicts.reason: Traceability records are in English and dated (completeness issues addressed under CP38/CP39).

verdicts.evidence: Track 1 §11 Indonesia requirements (PC, fumigation cert, aflatoxin ≤15 ppb); Track 9 fumigation treatment records
verdicts.reason: Importing country requirements are documented and addressed with supporting treatment records.
